summary: Ascentage Pharma (Form 6-K) furnished a voluntary announcement for an on-market share purchase by the trustee under its 2022 RSU scheme. On June 11, 2026, the trustee bought 110,000 shares (0.0294% of issued) at an average price of ~HK$33.37 per share, for total consideration of ~HK$3.67 million. The purchased shares are held for satisfying RSU vesting; voting rights are not exercised by the trustee. This is a routine administration of an equity incentive plan, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, premium, or structural changes involved.
